content: Supabase Storage: standard upload limit is plan dependent (Free 50MB; Pro+ up to 50GB via resumable TUS/S3, standard uploads 5GB); use resumable TUS (tus-js-client/Uppy) for video and the direct storage hostname for big files; upload directly from browser with a short-lived signed upload URL rather than proxying bytes through the API. Local dev TUS has had >6MB failures (supabase/cli #2729). Storage does not transcode video; needs external pipeline. Sources: supabase storage v3 blog, upload size troubleshooting doc, github issues.
